title: CSV action shows a loading state while exporting and a CSV export failed toast on failure
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the report with a large enough data set that the export takes a visible moment.
steps: 1. Choose "Download (CSV)" and immediately look at the menu action.
2. To provoke a failure, disconnect the network (or use browser dev tools offline mode) and choose "Download (CSV)" again.
expected: 1. While the export is in progress, the menu's CSV action shows a loading state and is non-interactive.
2. If the export fails, an error toast is shown: "CSV export failed." (dismissed by the user).
